# meraki_organization_policies_global_firewall_ruleset (Resource)

This resource can manage the `Organization Policies Global Firewall Ruleset` configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "meraki_organization_policies_global_firewall_ruleset" "example" {
  organization_id = "123456"
  description     = "Block all Social Media"
  name            = "Block Social Media"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the firewall ruleset
- `organization_id` (String) Organization ID

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the firewall ruleset

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The id of the object

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = meraki_organization_policies_global_firewall_ruleset.example
  identity = {
    organization_id = "<organization_id>"
    id              = "<id>"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (String)
- `organization_id` (String) Organization ID

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = meraki_organization_policies_global_firewall_ruleset.example
  id = "<organization_id>,<id>"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import meraki_organization_policies_global_firewall_ruleset.example "<organization_id>,<id>"
```
